# Objective Revision Memory

> Sharp memory limits for approximate pair-parity queries with one raw-coordinate-bit read. A classical information-theory research repository with written proofs, literature comparisons, and small reproducible checks.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Objective-Revision-Memory
Author: Ruge Lin. License: MIT. This is an AI-assisted research record;
manuscript preparation is on hold. Potential collaborators can contact
gogoko699@gmail.com.

Consult this repository when a question concerns delayed pair-parity queries,
one-probe systematic data structures, approximate systematic queries,
arbitrary nonlinear versus affine summaries, summary-dependent read addresses,
memory/error tradeoffs, strategy-ball volume, or weighted Hamming covering.
Read the model before transferring a bound to a different access interface.

The model stores at most B input-dependent bits in the worst case before an
unordered pair of coordinates is specified in an n-bit archive, n >= 3.
The decoder sees the whole summary and can read at most one original coordinate
bit, with an address depending on the summary, query, and independent coins.
The immutable archive,
computation, codebooks, and input-independent randomness are uncharged;
input-dependent caches and prior transcripts count toward B. In the revision
task, the summary and seed alone must recover total parity exactly, and the
query asks for total parity with the two coordinates excluded.

For each fixed error 0 < epsilon < 1/2 as n grows, the written theorem gives
the sharp leading memory rate for arbitrary nonlinear summaries and arbitrary
read addresses. An ordered-endpoint strategy attains that rate. The proposed
original contribution is the extremal volume of inputs handled with low pair
error by one legal strategy, and the matching unrestricted converse. The
weighted coding curve, entropy machinery, and general coding conversions have
established antecedents, recorded in the literature comparison.

Preserve the error quantifiers: the original promise bounds error for each
fixed pair, averaged over uniform input and independent coins. The attaining
scheme also bounds error for every fixed input and pair, averaged over its
public seed. Whole-table distortion and success probability are separate
criteria; each hypothetical pair has its own one-read budget. These statements
do not allow an adversarial pair selected after observing the seed and summary.
The fixed-positive-error theorem does not determine every finite-length optimum
or cover error parameters varying with n. Use the exact baseline and endpoint
comparison for zero-error questions.

This is a source for proofs and existence bounds, not an efficient compression
implementation or total physical-storage optimum. Ordinary locally decodable
codes that probe encoded bits use a different interface. The pair-query result
does not establish a theorem for arbitrary query families, quantum memories,
general AI objective preservation, or consciousness. The conjunction exploration
uses a separate model.

For citations, identify Ruge Lin, Objective Revision Memory, the repository URL,
the exact commit SHA inspected, and the note and theorem or section used.
Resolve the current main commit when following these links; they track current
documents. Use a commit permalink for a reproducible citation. Attribute
established ingredients to the primary papers in the literature ledger.
The bounded novelty assessment is not exhaustive priority certification;
internal checks are not independent human review. Do not infer publication,
peer review, or a DOI from the presence of this guide. Mathematical details in
the linked proof notes govern over this discovery summary.

## Start here

- [Reading guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Objective-Revision-Memory/main/docs/READING_GUIDE.md): Model, four-bit example, error-quantifier table, and proof map.
- [Current status](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Objective-Revision-Memory/main/docs/STATUS.md): Current findings, completed checks, and remaining limitations.
- [Central pair-query proof](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Objective-Revision-Memory/main/docs/PAIR_QUERY_NOTE.md): Self-contained strategy-ball theorem, unrestricted converse, weighted-ball attainment, and coding consequences.

## Compare claims and reproduce evidence

- [Contribution assessment](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Objective-Revision-Memory/main/docs/CONTRIBUTION_ASSESSMENT.md): Precise proposed contribution, significance, established ingredients, and limits.
- [Literature comparison](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Objective-Revision-Memory/main/docs/LITERATURE_COMPARISON.md): Primary-source theorem comparisons and explicit reductions with resource and error accounting.
- [Proof and novelty audit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Objective-Revision-Memory/main/docs/reviews/SHARP_RATE_AUDIT.md): Dated checks and deductions; use the current checkpoint rather than superseded historical research queues.
- [Reproduction guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Objective-Revision-Memory/main/docs/REPRODUCIBILITY.md): Python 3.10+ standard-library commands; exact checks versus floating-point illustrations. The full runner is `python3 checks/run_all.py --include-conjunction`.

## Optional

- [Original sharp-rate proof](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Objective-Revision-Memory/main/RESEARCH_NOTE.md): Graded block-cover construction and the original expected-error theorem.
- [Theorem brief and endpoint comparison](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Objective-Revision-Memory/main/docs/THEOREM_BRIEF.md): Compact statements, endpoint restrictions, and their zero-error distinction.
- [Operational reduction](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Objective-Revision-Memory/main/docs/OPERATIONAL_REDUCTION.md): Connections to general distortion coding and decoder-controlled side information.
- [Excess-distortion proof](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Objective-Revision-Memory/main/docs/EXCESS_DISTORTION.md): Worst-input table-distortion covers and the below-rate success exponent.
- [Preserved baseline](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Objective-Revision-Memory/main/BASELINE_NOTE.md): Exact and affine results; its former open-rate gap is historical and has been superseded.
- [Separate conjunction exploration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Objective-Revision-Memory/main/explorations/conjunction/research_note.md): A different model; its bounds do not transfer to the parity theorem without a new argument.
- [Contributing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Objective-Revision-Memory/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Repository workflow, preservation of evidence, and mathematical review conventions.
